title: Luna De Soleil | KEY.co
description_expanded: Step inside this beach retreat and discover a family-friendly open floor layout that exudes warmth and relaxation. The cozy separate living area, complete with a sofa and TV, provides an ideal spot for unwinding after a day of adventure. Moving through the home, you'll find a wonderful main living area where the kitchen island accommodates seating for three, and the dining table comfortably seats eight. The inviting sofa and loveseat frame the TV and entertainment center, creating the perfect ambiance for movie nights or simply winding down in the evening. Plus, there's a convenient half bath on the first level for added convenience. Upstairs, you'll find all three bedrooms, as well as a washer/dryer for your convenience. The master bedroom boasts a private bath, while Bedrooms two and three share a hallway bath with a tub-shower combination. Each bedroom also features a TV, ensuring everyone can relax in their own space. When you're ready to enjoy the outdoors, the home offers two covered porches, both perfect for savoring a cup of coffee or an afternoon cocktail. Whether you prefer grilling or simply lounging, you'll find the gas grill and comfortable seating areas to be just what you need.
